title: Introduce locally-indexed RAG debug watcher quickstart
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: developers asked for a tiny, reproducible authoring loop for RAG that mirrors production without requiring remote indexing services. This quickstart provides a local, incremental indexer + file-system watcher that keeps a compact on-disk index in sync and exposes a headless API shim suitable for CI/eval runs and interactive local development.

What this PR does: adds a new quickstart 'index-watcher' demonstrating: 1) a tiny incremental index format optimized for high-churn authoring (delta writes, append-only segments), 2) a cross-language example (TypeScript quick client + Python reindex worker), 3) a headless server mode for CI that accepts batched upserts and exposes an /ingest and /query HTTP surface, 4) embedded telemetry probes (step timers, fail-rate meters, token estimator), and 5) structured-output examples to show evaluation hooks.

Why it's different: unlike prior RAG quickstarts that assume a bulk index step, this one is focused on fast local edit loops: small writes, near-instant queries against recently-upserted content, and deterministic replay of index mutations for reproducible evals. The headless shim intentionally mimics a minimal private deployment surface so customers can iterate offline before moving to managed indexers.

How to run (local dev):
  - cd quickstarts/index-watcher
  - cp .env.example .env && npm install && pip install -r py-requirements.txt
  - npm run start:watch    # starts TS server and file watcher in dev mode (hot reload)
  - python reindex/worker.py --source samples/ --mode incremental  # starts lightweight reindexer that writes .ridx segments
  - curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/ingest -d '{"id":"doc1","text":"..."}'
  - curl http://localhost:8080/query?q=\"search term\"

Checklist (implemented):
  - [x] Headless HTTP shim and API surface for /ingest /query /status
  - [x] Incremental segment writer with compact on-disk layout and a simple manifest
  - [x] Example TS client + Python reindex worker demonstrating cross-language integration
  - [x] Devcontainer and small smoke CI job that runs quick unit + integration steps
  - [x] Instrumentation probes (OpenTelemetry-friendly metrics) and a readme for mapping probes to Redwood Console
  - [x] E2E smoke test script used by CI to validate deterministic replay

Files changed summary: added README with narrative, added two language examples, devcontainer, small CI job, telemetry mapping docs, and unit tests for segment merging and replay. No infra or production runtime changes. Backwards compatible quickstart addition.

CI notes: small flaky test in early run fixed by tightening sleep in watcher test. All checks green on rerun.

Related work: references ENG-6742 evaluation spike and the authoring playbook for RAG debug loops. This quickstart can be used as a staging pattern for private installer and dedicated on-prem reference later.
